name: outlook
description: Read local classic Outlook mail and calendar via COM, schedule meetings (fuzzy directory search, free/busy, and an unsent meeting draft you send yourself), open an agreed email or reply in Outlook as an unsent draft with your signature, print a day as a PDF planner, and print your team's open tasks (from Confluence and the emails you sent with a due date) as a double-sided sheet. It can never send anything. Windows only; requires pywin32.
